records.title: 10-Q
records.text: • Total revenue decreased by $12.4 million, or 12.5%, to $86.3 million from $98.7 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2022, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $181.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: • Operating margin decreased 10.3 percentage points to 7.3% from 17.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: • Cash provided by operating activities was $1.6 million, a decrease of $14.6 million from cash provided by operating activities of $16.2 million.
